column1: Traffic reports will resume on Thursday, March 5 at 4 p.m.

column4: All outbound lanes are shut down at New Circle Road prior to the overpass due to a semi on its side just past the overpass.
Outbound traffic diverted to the inner loop of New Circle Road.
Traffic exiting the inner loop of New Circle Road may proceed back onto the inner loop or inbound on Nicholasville Road.
